name: Embarcadero Center — podium level
note: 2026-10-03: the podium level as DECKS the ways take their height from (src/city/sf/bridges.ts EMBARCADERO_PODIUM_DECKS): the promenade, the skybridges and the Golden Gateway Garage's roof at one level, 8 m up. Replaces the four `embarcaderoUnit1..4` entries, whose 'gap between two towers' quads had landed across Battery, Front, Davis and Drumm streets — piers and well walls in the roadways (owner: 'walls block the way under them … somewhat the wrong footprints'). Their brick/colonnade/canopy vocabulary stays in sf/embarcadero.ts, to be re-placed on the low building:part rings south of the promenade. Draws nothing itself: the ways on the deck are drawn as raised walks (render/bridges.ts).

name: One Maritime Plaza Park
note: BUGS.md #180: the lawn with sculptures on the podium roof west of the One Maritime Plaza tower (way/28240176 — `embarcadero-maritime-aerial.png`), previously missing entirely. Placed by measuring way/28240176's own centroid/extent from the Overpass cache and offsetting west by its own half-width plus this court's half-width plus a small gap — not typed by eye. This is a FIFTH unit on its own footprint (a single tower over a garage), not one of the four `gapQuad` units, per the file header. The other half of #180 — the small brick building rendered sunken into the plaza — is a height-datum problem in whatever places that building on the ground instead of the deck; no such building is built by this file, so it is reported, not fixed here. 2026-10-03: baseY −81.3 puts its lawn (8 m up in its frame) on the declared podium deck, −73.3 (src/city/sf/bridges.ts EC_PODIUM_Y).
